Thanks for the note and the deck. Apologies — our CPO got delayed at the airport (flight rebooked, then pulled into an urgent call) so we had to pull leadership into a different thread at the last minute.

We still want to see Redwood — two asks:
1) Can we do a condensed 20-minute technical highlight this week (high-level latency/cost + KV cache handling)?
2) If not, please send a short recording I can share with the product team and we’ll pick a time next week.

Kate — thanks for the update.

We can absolutely do a 20-minute highlight this week. If Kate prefers the async route, I can record a 10-minute demo that focuses on:
- routing/fallbacks and how we keep apps online when a model variant is down
- prefix/KV caching impact on tail latency
- quick cost delta between standard and quantized profile for a 2k token workload

If we go live, I recommend bringing in Monica (Solutions Eng) for the 20-min slot to handle the quick architecture Qs. Monica — looping you in for availability and a possible short recording.
